name: logseq-plugin-sync-vault-with-geml
description: Sync Vault with GEML for Logseq 2.0 DB graphs: your graph as a continuously synced, Git-friendly plain-text vault (powered by GEML). The plugin signals the external logseq-sync watcher when the graph changes and shows the last sync result; the sync and git live in the watcher.

logseq.title: Sync Vault with GEML
logseq.description: Your DB graph as a continuously synced, Git-friendly plain-text vault (powered by GEML) — this plugin signals the external logseq-sync watcher and shows its status.
